Extension (issue-3-source-map.md): the Rumsey/IA road and rail maps carry an explicit CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 string with a separate "contact … for commercial use" instruction; NGE text is fair-use-only for non-commercial purposes. Modern FIPS codes (US-GA-<fips>) are a crosswalk key only; FIPS codes did not exist in 1942.
primarySource: Fenneman & Johnson 1946 physiographic divisions (USGS); NWI + GNIS are modern confirmation signals only, transparently labelled
rules: fall-line: Fenneman Piedmont fraction >= 0.20 AND Coastal Plain fraction >= 0.20 (county straddles the Fall Line boundary)
mountain: Blue Ridge + Valley and Ridge + Appalachian Plateaus fraction >= 0.50
piedmont: Piedmont fraction >= 0.50, or Piedmont+mountain-province >= 0.50 with Coastal Plain < 0.20
wetland: otherwise Coastal Plain AND modern GNIS swamp features >= 10 AND modern NWI polygon density >= 5.5 per km2 (modern signal only; not a 1942 observation)
coastal: all remaining Coastal Plain counties
UNCLASSIFIED Fenneman fraction (open water/coast) is excluded from province sums but reported as a flag

existingRoster.terrainForLogic: src/sim/scenario.ts terrainFor(): MOUNTAIN -> mountain; WETLAND -> wetland; centroidLat >= PIEDMONT_MIN_LAT -> piedmont; else coastal. No fall-line class exists in code.
existingRoster.centroidBasis: centroidLat taken from /tmp/issue-3-downloads/gnis-signals.json (prior-worker county centroid); may differ slightly from src/data/geometry.ts runtime centroid.
